chunks: I call to witness this city.

key_terms.أُقْسِمُ: I swear / I call to witness

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of God swearing by the city of Mecca in Surah Al-Balad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath by the sacred precincts of Mecca underscores the city's unique spiritual status as a sanctuary of monotheism, linking the physical sanctity of the Kaaba to the moral responsibility of its inhabitants. The verse sets the stage for the surah's central theme of human free will, contrasting the ease of life with the arduous path of righteousness that requires active striving rather than passive complacency.
